It is too often that people lose their passwords in more ways than one. It is possible that some people who browse Voat run or unintentionally run on connections which can allow an attacker to get the password as it was entered.

An optional second password that can be entered on the user's user page should be considered in this (but not limited to this) scenario: An optional secondary password that must be entered to change that users password.

Naturally, one can argue that if the user is already compromised they can get the password on Day 0 — but this hopefully helps decrease the chance of compromised accounts.
